senses.gloss: m. (צָמַת, v. צְמִיתוּת) irredeemably sold, forfeited.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 3:3:7">Y. Maasr. III, 50ᵈ</cite> <he>ואין צ׳ ביובל</he> (prob. to be read: <cite ref="R00601"><he>נִצְמָת</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="R00601"><he>צָמַת</he></cite>) and does not become irredeemable in the jubilee year (<cite ref="Sukkah 3b:3">Succ. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>ואינו נחלט</he>).
